items.question: What are Imani McGee-Stafford's WNBA career averages?
items.answer: Imani McGee-Stafford averaged 4.4 points and 4.2 rebounds in 121 WNBA regular-season games from 2016 to 2019. Her best season was her 2016 rookie year with Chicago, at 6.7 points and 5.6 rebounds.

items.question: How tall is Imani McGee-Stafford?
items.answer: Basketball-Reference lists Imani McGee-Stafford at 6 feet 7 inches; FIBA lists her at 6 feet 6 inches. She plays center.

items.question: Does Imani McGee-Stafford play for Puerto Rico?
items.answer: Yes. Imani McGee-Stafford played for Puerto Rico at the 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup, averaging 17.0 points and 12.0 rebounds in four games.

items.question: Which WNBA teams did Imani McGee-Stafford play for?
items.answer: The Chicago Sky drafted Imani McGee-Stafford 10th overall in 2016, and she made the All-Rookie Team. Chicago traded her to the Atlanta Dream in 2017, and she played for the Dallas Wings in 2019.

items.question: Where did Imani McGee-Stafford play college basketball?
items.answer: Imani McGee-Stafford played at Texas. In 2015 she received the Honda Inspiration Award.

items.question: Did Imani McGee-Stafford go to law school?
items.answer: Yes. In March 2020 she said she would sit out the next two WNBA seasons to attend Southwestern Law School in Los Angeles.
